name: metronome-gemini
description: Use /metronome and /html_replicate to investigate reporting folders and work with existing Metronome flows.

settings.name: SQL server
settings.description: Server name or IP address. Port 5432 is automatic; use server:port only for a different port. Leave blank to skip SQL for now.

settings.name: Read-only SQL username
settings.description: The account used to read your databases. Never use the upload account.

settings.name: Read-only SQL password
settings.description: Password for that read-only account. Input is masked and saved in Gemini's system keychain.
